items.question: Who does Roneeka Hodges coach?
items.answer: Roneeka Hodges is head coach of Phantom BC in Unrivaled, the 3-on-3 league. Before that she was a WNBA assistant coach with the New York Liberty (2022 to 2024), where she won the 2024 WNBA title, and with the Connecticut Sun, who hired her in January 2025.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did Roneeka Hodges play for?
items.answer: Roneeka Hodges played 11 WNBA seasons, from 2005 to 2015, for the Houston Comets, Minnesota Lynx, San Antonio Silver Stars, Indiana Fever, Tulsa Shock and Atlanta Dream. Houston drafted her 15th overall in 2005 out of Florida State, and she averaged 6.0 points in 320 regular-season games.
